headline: OPEC+ Expected to Keep First-Quarter 2027 Oil Production Targets Unchanged
summary: OPEC+ is set to maintain its first-quarter 2027 oil output targets unchanged at its upcoming meeting amid uncertainties over regional conflict and capacity estimates.
why: OPEC+ production quotas are the primary determinant of global crude oil supply, directly impacting international energy prices and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Maintaining production quotas directly affects global crude oil supply and pricing dynamics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
